implementation.residual: field mean divided by GP, point and model uncertainty
implementation.safety_separation: semantic candidate segmentation never removes collision returns

negative_cases: invalid and non-finite cloud points rejected
static points excluded only from semantic candidates
insufficient points rejected with typed reason
bounded translation and yaw steps enforced
flat/degenerate view cannot claim reliable yaw
finite result and covariance schema enforced

limitations: The fixture does not establish real-cloud origin error or false-match rate.
No verified complete opponent geometry or T_B_M calibration is available.
The covariance is local estimator information and does not include all shared ego/model calibration correlations.
The current segmenter is deterministic Euclidean clustering; density/range-adaptive production parameters remain to be calibrated.
No safety collision evidence is allowed to depend on registration success.
